question: Should this PR switch fresh Cohere onboarding and modern live sweeps to Command A+ before credentialed Cohere live proof is available?
rationale: The diff changes user-facing provider defaults and live-sweep behavior for a protected maintainer-labeled draft PR, and the PR body says the direct Cohere call could not be run without credentials.

options.title: Wait For Live Proof
options.body: Keep the PR draft until a redacted Cohere live run validates Command A+ selection and the relevant reasoning/tool metadata, with the changelog edit removed before merge.

options.title: Waive Provider Proof
options.body: A maintainer may decide official docs plus focused catalog/payload tests are enough and explicitly waive the missing credentialed Cohere call.

options.title: Keep Old Default
options.body: Add the current models but keep `command-a-03-2025` as the fresh onboarding default until the Command A+ availability/default policy is confirmed.

recommendation.title: Wait For Live Proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR draft until a redacted Cohere live run validates Command A+ selection and the relevant reasoning/tool metadata, with the changelog edit removed before merge.
